<b>Sharpdart</b> is a [[Skills|Skill]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It allows [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to dash forward in a blur of blade and [[Silk]] that pierces [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]].

== Function ==
Hornet dashes forward with the [[Needle]] extended, passing through and damaging enemies, followed by a set of 3 small slashes on each enemy hit. Sharpdart deals [[Damage Values and Enemy Health (Silksong)#Needle|2.75x Needle]] [[Heavy Damage]] on the dash and 0.25x Needle Damage on the smaller strikes, rounding up, resulting in a total of 3.5x Needle Damage. The three extra hits are not affected by [[Shaman Crest]] or [[Volt Filament]].

During the dash and for a brief period afterwards, Hornet cannot be hit by enemy attacks or take contact damage from enemies. However, she can still be hit by environmental hazards such as spikes. Furthermore, there is a brief delay between the button for the skill being input and the dash occurring where Hornet is still fully vulnerable and the dash can be interrupted.

=== Modifiers ===
* [[Volt Filament]] electrifies Sharpdart, increasing the damage of the initial hit by 25% and adding a tick of 5 damage.
* [[Shaman Crest]] sheathes Sharpdart in Soul, increasing the damage of the initial hit by 40%.
** Volt Filament and Shaman Crest's damage increases add together to grant +65% damage.
* [[Egg of Flealia]] reduces the cost of Sharpdart to 3 [[Silk]] while at full health.

== How to Acquire ==
Sharpdart can be acquired from a [[Weaver Burial Spire]] in [[Weavenest Karn]] of the [[Wormways]], which requires the [[Needolin]] to enter. [[Clawline]] is recommended to reach the Needolin door, though reaching it with just [[Drifter's Cloak]] and [[Swift Step]] is possible.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FMh-vYr3VO0 Silksong – Early Weavenest Karn Sharpdart No Clawline, Act 1]</ref>
